summary: Walton County steel lookout tower, dismantled and moved to a private location on January 2, 2004; no build, design or staffing record found.

facts.status_note: Dismantled and moved to a private location on January 2, 2004. The new site is not named.

access.note: The record describes the new location as private and names no public access.

events.note: Dismantled and moved to a private location; the new site is not named

evidence.supports: Steel tower dismantled and moved to a private location
evidence.quote: The steel tower was dismantled and moved to a private location.

corrections.why: The source says the steel tower was dismantled and moved to a private location in 2004, so it is not simply gone. The new site is not named.

notes_for_editor: One source only (Eastern U.S. Lookouts), with one dated line. The story is shorter than the 120-word floor because the evidence stops there, and I did not pad it. Two WebSearch queries, plus reads of the Argyle Fire District history page, the Walton County Heritage Volume 12 contents and the cached Wikipedia page for Argyle, found no mention of a tower. The heritage contents list a 'Forest Fires in Walton' article that I could not open. The status is 'relocated' because the source says the tower was moved, but no new site is named. The editor may prefer to hold this story until a second source turns up.
